description: This Java class 'PotCommand' provides a GUI component for controlling a potentiometer channel, including UI elements for setting resistance and voltage, and methods for calculating resistance values and sending commands to hardware.

classes.name: PotCommand
classes.description: A GUI component class for controlling a potentiometer channel, including UI elements and static methods for resistance calculations and command requests.

methods.name: PotCommand
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GUI panel for a specific potentiometer channel.

methods.name: requestPotChange
methods.description: Sends a command to change the potentiometer resistance for a given channel.

methods.name: getPotResistance
methods.description: Calculates the resistance value needed for a specified output voltage and reference voltage.

methods.name: getRbyD
methods.description: Converts a digital value to a resistance value.

methods.name: getR1InVoltageDivider3
methods.description: Calculates the resistance in a voltage divider based on output voltage, input voltage, and load resistance.
